m-tallahassee|2026-01-28|46159130|dc65ae.title: On August 22, 2024, the CRA Board adopted the FY 2025 budget, which listed projected revenues, reserves, and prior-year funds of $14,273,000, operating expenses of $1,221,000, and capital expenses of $8,276,000. At the end of the year, the actual FY 2025 revenues, reserves, and prior-year funds were $20,540,000, actual operating expenses for both districts were $898,000, and the final FY 2025 capital expenditures were $11,111,000, which included project and program expenditures approved by the CRA Board and the CRA Executive Director after the budget was adopted.
